test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Data Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records data at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: EMS software is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System clock is synchronized.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS interface for a continuous period of at least 10 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays real-time temperature readings for all monitored GMP storage areas without interruption.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of EMS interface showing continuous monitoring.
Timestamp of observation.

test_steps.action: Access the recorded data logs for the observed period.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are recorded for each sensor at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_to_capture: Exported data log file.
Analysis of data log timestamps to confirm recording intervals.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS continuously displays temperature readings for all GMP storage areas.
All recorded temperature data points are within 5-minute intervals.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is recorded accurately and without loss.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range and accuracy, and generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint.
prerequisites: EMS software is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
A calibrated reference thermometer is available.
A controlled temperature environment (e.g., environmental chamber) is available for testing.

test_steps.action: Place a calibrated reference thermometer adjacent to an EMS sensor in a GMP storage area. Set the EMS setpoint to a nominal value (e.g., 20°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays a temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the reference thermometer reading.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of EMS interface showing temperature reading.
Reading from the calibrated reference thermometer.
Timestamp of readings.

test_steps.action: Gradually adjust the temperature in the controlled environment to simulate a deviation of +2°C from the setpoint (e.g., 22°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification within 30 seconds, indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of EMS alert notification.
Timestamp of alert generation.
Reading from the calibrated reference thermometer.

test_steps.action: Gradually adjust the temperature in the controlled environment to simulate a deviation of -2°C from the setpoint (e.g., 18°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification within 30 seconds, indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of EMS alert notification.
Timestamp of alert generation.
Reading from the calibrated reference thermometer.

test_steps.action: Return the temperature to within the acceptable range (e.g., 20°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS clears the alert or indicates the temperature is back within normal range.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of EMS interface showing alert cleared or normal status.
Timestamp of alert clearance.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings displayed by the EMS are within ±0.5°C of the calibrated reference thermometer.
Alerts are generated within 30 seconds for temperature deviations of ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alerts are cleared when the temperature returns to the acceptable range.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings are accurate and reflect actual conditions.
Alarm triggers are reliable and timely.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system uses vendor-supplied software without modification and that all data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
Access to EMS system configuration and database.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS system's software installation directory and configuration files.
test_steps.expected_result: No unauthorized modifications are present in the vendor-supplied software files or configurations.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of software installation directory.
Confirmation of no custom code or configuration changes.

test_steps.action: Query the EMS database to inspect the format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: The stored data adheres to the documented standard database format provided by the vendor.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of database schema or sample data records.
Confirmation of data format matching vendor documentation.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system software is confirmed to be unmodified from the vendor's original installation.
The format of stored environmental data matches the vendor's specified standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a verifiable and standard format to ensure integrity and future retrieval.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification and Response Time
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates alerts when temperature deviates from setpoint and that the system response time for alarm conditions meets the specified requirement.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational and configured with a setpoint.
Site paging system is operational and configured to receive notifications.
Access to a controlled environment chamber or method to simulate temperature deviations.

test_steps.action: Set a temperature setpoint within the EMS system (e.g., 20°C).
test_steps.expected_result: Setpoint is successfully configured in the EMS system.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of setpoint configuration.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation of +2°C from the setpoint (e.g., 22°C) in a monitored area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS system generates an alarm notification for the temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of temperature deviation.
Screenshot of alarm generated in EMS interface.

test_steps.action: Measure the time from the moment the temperature deviation occurs to the moment the alarm notification is received by the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The system response time for the alarm condition does not exceed 30 seconds.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of alarm notification receipt on paging system.
Calculated response time.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation of -2°C from the setpoint (e.g., 18°C) in a monitored area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS system generates an alarm notification for the temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of temperature deviation.
Screenshot of alarm generated in EMS interface.

test_steps.action: Measure the time from the moment the temperature deviation occurs to the moment the alarm notification is received by the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The system response time for the alarm condition does not exceed 30 seconds.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of alarm notification receipt on paging system.
Calculated response time.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system generates an alarm when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
The system response time for alarm conditions is less than or equal to 30 seconds.
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate and timely alarm notifications are critical for maintaining product integrity.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system maintains a comprehensive audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A simulated event requiring an audit trail entry (e.g., configuration change) is planned.

test_steps.action: Perform a configuration change within the EMS system (e.g., adjust a setpoint or alarm threshold).
test_steps.expected_result: An audit trail entry is generated, recording the user, date, time, action performed, and the old and new values.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entries for the performed action.

test_steps.action: Attempt to approve a critical report or action using an electronic signature.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for user credentials and a reason for the signature. Upon successful authentication, the signature is applied, and the action is marked as approved.
data_to_capture: Electronic signature details (user, date, time, reason).

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail and electronic signature records for completeness and accuracy.
test_steps.expected_result: All recorded events and signatures are accurate, complete, and in the expected format.
data_to_capture: Screenshots or exported logs of audit trail and electronic signature records.

acceptance_criteria: All audit trail entries accurately reflect system events, including user, date, time, and changes.
Electronic signatures are correctly applied and associated with the appropriate actions.
Audit trail and electronic signature data is retained and accessible.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be secure, unalterable, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures must be unique to the individual and linked to the signed record.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Retention Capabilities
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can archive historical data and retain it for the required 7-year period.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to test the archival process (or simulated data can be generated).
Archival destination is configured and accessible.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archival process as per vendor documentation.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives a defined set of historical data to the designated archival location.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of archival process completion.
Location and timestamp of archived data.

test_steps.action: Verify the integrity and accessibility of the archived data.
test_steps.expected_result: The archived data is intact, readable, and can be retrieved for review.
data_to_capture: Sample of retrieved archived data.
Verification of data format consistency.

test_steps.action: Simulate the passage of time or adjust system settings to confirm data retention policies are enforced.
test_steps.expected_result: Data older than the retention period is either automatically purged or clearly marked as archived and inaccessible for routine use, as per system configuration.
data_to_capture: System logs indicating data management actions.
Verification of data availability based on retention period.

acceptance_criteria: Data archival process completes successfully without errors.
Archived data is retrievable and maintains its integrity.
System enforces the 7-year data retention policy.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be retained in a secure and unalterable format.
Archived data must be retrievable for the entire retention period.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Usage for Batch Release
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-supplied standard reports for batch release purposes as defined in the URS.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
Sufficient historical data exists to generate reports.
Access to vendor-supplied standard reports is confirmed.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS system.
test_steps.expected_result: The reporting module is accessible and displays available standard reports.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the reporting module interface.

test_steps.action: Select a standard report designed for batch release (e.g., a summary of temperature data for a specific period).
test_steps.expected_result: The selected standard report is generated successfully, displaying relevant data.
data_to_capture: Name of the selected standard report.
Screenshot of the generated report.

test_steps.action: Review the generated report for accuracy and completeness against the URS requirements for batch release data.
test_steps.expected_result: The report contains accurate and complete data that aligns with the requirements for batch release.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of report accuracy and completeness.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully generates vendor-supplied standard reports.
The generated reports are suitable for use in batch release decisions.
Report content is accurate and complete as per URS-EMS-007.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Reports must accurately reflect the stored data.
No data manipulation should occur during report generation.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system meets the specified availability percentage and has sufficient data storage capacity for 10 years of continuous monitoring.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
System monitoring tools are in place to track uptime.
Knowledge of the system's data storage configuration.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 1 week) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: The total unplanned downtime is less than the allowed percentage for 99.5% availability over the monitoring period.
data_to_capture: Total monitoring period duration.
Total unplanned downtime duration.
Calculated availability percentage.

test_steps.action: Review system logs and configuration to determine current data storage utilization.
test_steps.expected_result: Current data storage utilization is significantly below the total capacity, indicating sufficient space for 10 years of data.
data_to_capture: Current data storage utilization (e.g., GB used).
Total data storage capacity (e.g., GB available).

test_steps.action: Calculate the estimated data generation rate per day/month based on monitoring intervals and number of sensors.
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated data generation rate is reasonable and aligns with system specifications.
data_to_capture: Estimated data generation rate (e.g., MB/day).

test_steps.action: Project the total data storage required for 10 years based on the calculated data generation rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The projected 10-year data storage requirement is less than or equal to the available storage capacity.
data_to_capture: Projected 10-year data storage requirement (e.g., TB).

acceptance_criteria: System availability is at least 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
Data storage capacity is sufficient to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
URS-EMS-012 and URS-EMS-013 are met.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-012: Data storage capacity shall support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.
URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: System must remain operational to collect and store data.
Sufficient storage is critical to prevent data loss.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System can successfully interface with the existing facility management system using standard protocols.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Facility Management System (FMS) is operational and accessible.
Network connectivity between EMS and FMS is established.
Details of the standard protocols used for integration are documented.

test_steps.action: Initiate data transfer from EMS to FMS using the defined standard protocols.
test_steps.expected_result: Data from EMS is successfully transmitted and received by the FMS without errors.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of data transfer initiation.
Confirmation of successful data transmission from EMS logs.
Confirmation of successful data reception in FMS logs.
Any error messages or logs generated during the transfer.

test_steps.action: Verify that the data received by the FMS accurately reflects the data being monitored by the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature and humidity data displayed in the FMS matches the data recorded by the EMS for the same time period.
data_to_capture: Sample data points from EMS.
Corresponding data points from FMS.
Comparison of data values.

acceptance_criteria: Data transfer between EMS and FMS is successful and error-free.
Data integrity is maintained during the integration process.
The FMS accurately displays the environmental monitoring data.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-014: System shall interface with existing facility management system via standard protocols.
data_integrity_requirements: Data transmitted to FMS must be accurate and complete.
No data loss or corruption during transmission.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification Integration with Paging System
test_cases.objective: To verify that alarm notifications generated by the EMS are successfully integrated with the site paging system using the vendor API.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API for alarm notification is documented and accessible.
Test alarm conditions are defined and can be triggered.

test_steps.action: Trigger a test alarm condition in the EMS (e.g., temperature deviation outside setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of alarm trigger.
Details of the triggered alarm (e.g., sensor ID, parameter, value).

test_steps.action: Verify that the EMS sends the alarm notification to the site paging system via the vendor API.
test_steps.expected_result: The paging system receives the alarm notification from the EMS.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of alarm transmission from EMS logs.
Confirmation of alarm reception in paging system logs.
Any error messages or logs generated during the API call.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification received by the paging system contains accurate and relevant information.
test_steps.expected_result: The paging system displays the correct alarm details (e.g., location, parameter, severity).
data_to_capture: Content of the alarm message received by the paging system.
Comparison with the triggered alarm details.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications are successfully sent from EMS to the paging system.
Alarm notifications contain accurate and complete information.
The integration with the paging system functions as per the vendor API documentation.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm notification content must be accurate and not corrupted.
Timeliness of alarm notification is critical.
